Navya answered who/what/where questions about the story and applied the copying idea to clapping in a new situation; this was shown.
Navya practised putting pictures in order using “first, then, at last”; the order was not steady yet and needs checking next time.

Navya retold that the monkeys took the caps and copied the cap-seller throwing his cap.
end.parentNote: Navya practised story questions, picture sequencing, and explaining why the cap-seller’s trick worked. They used “first, then, at last” in a retell and applied the copying idea to a new example about clapping. The mix-up that the caps were thrown because they were too big came up again and was not corrected later. At home, show three story pictures and ask Navya to put them in order and say why the monkeys copied the cap-seller.
